title: The Overall result of the year
subtitle: 可持续发展 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 可持续发展（人与自然·环境保护·可持续发展）
meta: 主题语境：可持续发展（人与自然·环境保护·可持续发展）　|　核心词汇：overall　|　正文 346 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 overall 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1983 the foreman wrote of ① an overall result of the year in the sheet, and everybody in the site said at once that it was ② so overall that nobody in the site would go near it. Three shifts on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the foreman, who never explained anything, had done it for the whole place and gone home; it was the overall ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the overall result of the year that anybody there had ever seen, or so the sheet for May 1977 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too overall to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the worker who had come to help; the overall ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the rope at the far ramp, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an overall plan for the coast, and said that no worker in his right mind would call it ⑥ as overall as the plan for the coast they had once had in the old site. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was overall or not, and he said so.

By 1990 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the sheet. What the line asked for was ⑦ something overall, and nothing besides. The worker from the next site called the whole plan ⑧ quite overall; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the sheet kept the names of the overall ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1993, without a word of thanks, she wrote of another overall result of the year in the same sheet, and the work, which took two shifts, seemed ⑨ no less overall than anybody had expected. ⑩ The overall plan for the coast that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1995, was the one she could never quite name; the overall ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 总体（前置定语 an overall result of the year：1983 年工头在施工单里记下的那件总体的成绩）
B. adj. 总体／全面（两处加强说法：so overall that … 与 no less overall than …）
C. adj. 总体／全面（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 总体（表语 too overall to do：母亲觉得它太总体，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 全面（前置定语 an overall plan for the coast：叔叔把整件事称作一桩全面的整体规划）
F. adj. 全面（同级比较 as overall as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩海岸带的整体规划相比）
G. adj. 全面（后置定语 something overall：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 全面（受程度副词修饰 quite overall：那位工人的评价）

items.q: an overall result of the year
the overall result of the year that
an overall plan for the coast
The overall plan for the coast that

answers.why: overall 意为“总体”，1983 年工头在施工单里记下的是“一件总体的成绩”，此处作前置定语 an overall result of the year。
overall 意为“总体”，此处用 so overall that 结构，说它总体到工地里没人敢靠近。
overall 意为“总体”，施工单上 五月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的总体全年的总体成绩，等于最高级的说法。
overall 意为“总体”，母亲认为这件东西“太总体了，谁也用不上”，too overall to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
overall 意为“全面”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩全面的整体规划”，此处作前置定语 an overall plan for the coast。
overall 意为“全面”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩海岸带的整体规划一样全面”，同级比较用 as overall as。
overall 意为“全面”，施工单上那半行字要的是“全面的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something overall。
overall 意为“全面”，邻工地来的那位工人认为这套计划“相当全面”，quite 修饰原级 overall。
overall 意为“全面”，no less overall than 表示“其全面不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之全面不亚于任何人的预料。
overall 意为“全面”，母亲 1995 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的全面整体规划”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1983 年，工头在施工单里记下了一件总体的成绩。（an overall result of the year）
它总体到工地里没有一个人敢靠近。（so overall that …）
母亲觉得它太总体，谁也用不上。（too overall to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩全面的整体规划。（an overall plan for the coast）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩海岸带的整体规划一样全面。（as overall as …）
到了 1990 年，施工单上只剩半行字：要的是一件全面的东西。（something overall）
answers: In 1983 the foreman wrote of an overall result of the year in the sheet.
It was so overall that nobody in the site would go near it.
My mother thought it too overall to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an overall plan for the coast.
He said nobody would call it as overall as the plan for the coast they had once had.
By 1990 the sheet asked for nothing but something overall.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 overall 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1983 the foreman wrote of an overall result of the year in the sheet, and nobody forgot it.
It was the overall result of the year that anybody there had ever seen, or so the sheet says.
My mother thought it too overall to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an overall plan for the coast, and nobody argued with him.
The worker from the next site called the plan quite overall, and everybody laughed.
The overall ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
